optionsEn: The special public prosecutor or the counsel while recording communicate the question to be put to the child to the special court which again put those questions to the child
Permit frequent breaks for the child during the trial
Shall create a friendly atmosphere for the child by allowing the presence of any member of child's family, custodian friend or relative
optionsHi: लोक अभियोजक या काउंसेल बालक की परीक्षा अभिलिखित करते समय बालक से पूछे जाने वाले प्रश्न विशेष न्यायालय को संसूचित करेगा, जो पुन; उन प्रश्नों को बालक के समक्ष रखेगा।
